description: arXiv:2610.32281v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Negation occurs in every language, yet its surface realization differs drastically. Despite this, multilingual large language models (LLMs) translate negation robustly, raising the question of whether they share an underlying representation of negation across languages. We study this question in six open models across English, French, Vietnamese...
author: Giang Son Nguyen, Wray Buntine, Dung D. Le, Wenya Wang
